title: 真假金丝雀的博弈第18章
content_zh:
第18章 最后的牌

    许向平的电话比预想的来得更快。不是周三，是周二上午。

    我正坐在公寓的书桌前整理苏婉清项目的调研提纲，手机屏幕亮起来，上面显示一串没有存的号码。但我认识那串数字——上次在万盛会议室里，许向平签完协议之后用这个号码给我发过一条消息，只有四个字：后会有期。

    我接起来。

    “温小姐，恭喜。听说你自己开公司了。”

    “许总消息灵通。”

    “苏婉清的项目，你吃得下吗？”他连寒暄都省了，声音里没有了上次在画廊里那种强撑的体面，只剩下一层薄薄的平静，像冰面覆盖着一锅沸水。

    “吃不吃得下是我的事。许总有事可以直接说。”

    “下午三点，万盛对面那家咖啡馆。你一个人来。”

    “许总有什么话电话里说就行。”

    “有些东西电话里说不清楚。”他顿了一下，“比如顾明珠的转账记录原件，比如郑其明手里那份关于顾氏财务漏洞的报告草稿。你想要，就拿林曼如的画廊股份来换。”

    电话挂了。

    我坐在椅子上看着手机屏幕慢慢暗下去。许向平手里还有牌。郑其明的报告草稿是新的信息，上次在方总的饭局上郑其明没有提到任何报告的事，如果他在写一份针对顾氏的财务漏洞报告，说明许向平根本没有真正退出并购案的竞争，他只是换了个方式继续打。而顾明珠的转账记录原件如果被他公开，顾明珠在顾家就彻底待不下去了。

    我给顾西辞发了条消息：许向平约我下午三点见面。他手里有郑其明的报告草稿和顾明珠的转账原件。

    顾西辞直接打了电话过来。

    “不许去。”

    “我不去他会把顾明珠的转账记录公开。”

    “公开就公开。顾明珠收钱的时候就应该想到有今天。”

    “她收钱是因为在顾家待不下去。这件事我管了就不会半路松手。”我把手机夹在耳朵和肩膀之间，腾出手来把桌上的调研提纲装进文件袋，“而且郑其明在写顾氏的财务漏洞报告。上次方总饭局上他一个字都没提，说明这份报告是在并购案签约之后才启动的。许向平退出了并购案，但没有退出竞争。他在找下一个突破口。”

    电话那头安静了片刻。

    “我跟你一起去。”

    “他让我一个人去。”

    “你一个人去就是羊入虎口。”

    “我不是羊。”我站起来走到窗边，“许向平现在手里攥着两张牌想跟我换林曼如的画廊股份，这说明他已经没招了。真正有招的人不会拿别人的秘密来换东西。他的底牌是两张快要作废的借条——顾明珠的钱已经还了，郑其明的报告还没写完。你只要在咖啡馆外面等着。”

    “好。十五分钟你不出来我就进去。”

    下午三点整，万盛集团对面的咖啡馆。许向平坐在角落里，面前放着一杯没动过的美式咖啡。他瘦了，颧骨比上次在万盛会议室里更突出，西装还是笔挺的，但衬衫领口松了一颗扣子。他看见我走进来，没有站起来，只是朝对面的椅子做了个手势。

    “坐。”

    我坐下，把包放在脚边。服务员过来问我要什么，我说不用。许向平把咖啡杯推到一边，双手交叉放在桌上。

    “林曼如的画廊，你投了多少钱？”

    “商业机密。”

    “我是她丈夫。”

    “法律上还是。但画廊的事跟她和你之间的婚姻是两码事。你签过协议不骚扰她的画廊。”我看着他的眼睛，“今天你拿顾明珠和郑其明来换画廊股份，说明你已经没有别的东西可以用了。”

    他的眼角跳了一下，但很快就恢复了。他端起咖啡喝了一口，动作很慢，好像在品尝咖啡的味道，但我知道他在品尝的不是咖啡。

    “郑其明的报告初稿我看过了。顾氏并购案的财务模型里有一个假设前提——万盛不会再参与同赛道竞争。这个假设在合同里没有写，但在方总做决策的时候起了决定性作用。如果万盛重新入局，顾氏对合作方的承诺就站不住脚。”

    “你拿什么重新入局？万盛的董事会已经不信任你了。苏婉清绕过你找外部团队做品牌诊断，你连自己丈母娘的项目都管不住。”

    这句话戳到了他最痛的地方。他的手在咖啡杯上顿了一下，指节泛白。

    “苏婉清是被你蛊惑的。林曼如也是。”他把杯子放下，声音压得很低，“你一个一个地把我身边的人拉走——我太太，我岳母，现在连顾明珠都被你收了。你到底想要什么？”

    “我只想要我应得的东西。”

    “什么？”

    “林太太的画廊她自己做主。顾明珠的名誉她自己挣回来。苏太太的品牌她自己找人做。这三件事跟你没有关系。你今天约我来，想拿两张快要作废的牌换画廊股份，我只能告诉你——顾明珠的转账记录原件，顾氏法务部已经备份了。她收钱的时候确实犯了错，但她把钱退回去了，也配合了调查。许总如果公开这份记录，顾家可能会怪她一时糊涂，但更会查是谁在背后给她塞钱。”

    许向平的脸色变了。我把水杯往边上挪了挪，继续说下去。

    “至于郑其明的报告，他写的是草稿，不是终稿。他手里关于顾氏财务模型的数据是从方总那边侧面打听来的，不是一手资料。如果他敢把这份报告交给媒体，顾氏法务部会以传播不实信息为由起诉。你觉得郑其明会为了你赌上自己的职业信誉吗？”

    “郑其明跟了我八年。”

    “八年。他跟了你八年，然后上周给你岳母的品牌项目提供了竞品分析数据。你不知道吧？苏婉清找咨询公司比稿，郑其明私下递了方案。”我停了一下，让这个信息的重量完全落在他身上，“他已经开始在两头下注了。许总，你手里没有人了。”

    许向平的手从咖啡杯上移开，放在桌上。那只手很稳，但他的呼吸变了——不是急促，是更深、更慢。他是一个老练的牌手，知道什么时候该扣牌认输。他盯着我看了很长一段时间，然后忽然笑了一下。那个笑容很轻很淡，像一个输光了筹码的人最后一次翻开底牌，发现连底牌都是白纸。
content_en:
Chapter 18 The Final Card
Xu Xiangping's call came faster than expected. It's not Wednesday, it's Tuesday morning.
I was sitting at the desk in my apartment, sorting out the research outline for Su Wanqing's project, when the screen of my phone lit up, showing a string of unsaved numbers. But I recognize that string of numbers - last time in the Wansheng conference room, Xu Xiangping used this number to send me a message after signing the agreement. There were only four words: See you later.
I picked up.
"Ms. Wen, congratulations. I heard that you started your own company."
"Mr. Xu is well-informed."
"Can you eat Su Wanqing's project?" He even skipped the pleasantries, and his voice lost the forced dignity he had last time in the gallery. There was only a thin layer of calmness left, like ice covering a pot of boiling water.
"Whether you can eat it or not is my business. If you have something to do, Mr. Xu can just say it directly."
"At three o'clock in the afternoon, the cafe opposite Wansheng. You come alone."
"Mr. Xu, just call me if you have anything to say."
"There are some things that were unclear on the phone." He paused, "For example, the original transfer record of Gu Mingzhu, or the draft report on Gu's financial loopholes in Zheng Qiming's hand. If you want it, just exchange it for Lin Manru's gallery shares."
The phone was hung up.
I sat on the chair and watched the phone screen slowly dim. Xu Xiangping still has cards in his hand. Zheng Qiming's draft report is new information. Zheng Qiming did not mention anything about the report at Mr. Fang's dinner last time. If he is writing a financial vulnerability report against Gu, it means that Xu Xiangping has not really withdrawn from the competition for the merger and acquisition case at all. He just changed his way to continue fighting. And if Gu Mingzhu's original transfer record is disclosed by him, Gu Mingzhu will not be able to stay in the Gu family at all.
I sent a message to Gu Xici: Xu Xiangping asked me to meet at three o'clock in the afternoon. He had Zheng Qiming's draft report and Gu Mingzhu's original transfer in his hands.
Gu Xici called directly.
"Don't go."
"If I don't go, he will make Gu Mingzhu's transfer records public."
"If it's public, it's public. Gu Mingzhu should have thought about this day when she accepted the money."
"She took the money because she couldn't stay in the Gu family. I won't let go of this matter if I take care of it." I put the phone between my ear and my shoulder, freeing up my hands to put the research outline on the table into the document bag, "And Zheng Qiming is writing Gu's financial vulnerability report. He didn't mention a word at Mr. Fang's dinner last time, indicating that this report was only launched after the merger and acquisition project was signed. Xu Xiangping withdrew from the merger and acquisition project, but did not withdraw from the competition. He is looking for the next breakthrough."
There was silence on the other end of the phone for a moment.
"I'll go with you."
"He told me to go alone."
"If you go alone, you will be like a sheep in a tiger's mouth."
"I'm not a sheep." I stood up and walked to the window. "Xu Xiangping is holding two cards in his hand and wants to exchange Lin Manru's gallery shares with me. This shows that he has run out of tricks. People who are really smart will not trade other people's secrets for things. His trump card is two IOUs that are about to be invalidated - Gu Mingzhu's money has been paid back, and Zheng Qiming's report has not been finished yet. You just need to wait outside the cafe."
"Okay. If you don't come out in fifteen minutes, I'll go in."
At three o'clock in the afternoon, the cafe opposite Wansheng Group. Xu Xiangping sat in the corner with an untouched cup of American coffee in front of him. He has lost weight, and his cheekbones are more prominent than last time in the Wansheng conference room. His suit is still straight, but one button is loose at the collar of his shirt. When he saw me walking in, he didn't stand up, but just gestured to the chair opposite.
"sit."
I sat down and put my bag at my feet. The waiter came over and asked me what I wanted, and I said no. Xu Xiangping pushed the coffee cup aside and crossed his hands on the table.
"How much money did you invest in Lin Manru's gallery?"
"Trade Confidential."
"I am her husband."
"Legally, it is. But the gallery matter is different from the marriage between her and you. You signed an agreement not to harass her gallery." I looked into his eyes, "Today you exchanged Gu Mingzhu and Zheng Qiming for gallery shares, which means you have nothing else to use."
The corners of his eyes twitched, but he quickly recovered. He picked up the coffee and took a sip, very slowly, as if he was tasting the coffee, but I knew that what he was tasting was not coffee.
"I have read the first draft of Zheng Qiming's report. There is an assumption in the financial model of Gu's merger and acquisition case - Wansheng will no longer compete in the same track. This assumption was not written in the contract, but it played a decisive role in Mr. Fang's decision-making. If Wansheng re-enters the game, Gu's commitment to the partner will be untenable."
"Why do you want to re-enter? Wansheng's board of directors no longer trusts you. Su Wanqing bypassed you and found an external team to do brand diagnosis. You can't even control your mother-in-law's projects."
This sentence hit him where it hurt the most. His hand paused on the coffee cup, his knuckles turning white.
"Su Wanqing was bewitched by you. So was Lin Manru." He put down the cup and spoke in a low voice, "You took away the people around me one by one - my wife, my mother-in-law, and now even Gu Mingzhu has been taken over by you. What do you want?"
"I just want what I deserve."
"What?"
"Mrs. Lin's gallery is her own decision. Gu Mingzhu's reputation is earned by herself. Mrs. Su's brand is created by someone else. These three things have nothing to do with you. You invited me here today to exchange two cards that are about to become invalid for gallery shares. I can only tell you - Gu Mingzhu The original transfer record has been backed up by Gu's legal department. She did make a mistake when collecting the money, but she returned the money and cooperated with the investigation. If Mr. Xu disclosed this record, the Gu family might blame her for being confused, but they would also find out who was behind her back. "
Xu Xiangping's expression changed. I moved the water glass to the side and continued.
"As for Zheng Qiming's report, he wrote a draft, not a final draft. The data about Gu's financial model in his hand was obtained from Mr. Fang, not first-hand information. If he dares to hand this report to the media, Gu's Legal Department will sue for spreading false information. Do you think Zheng Qiming will put his professional reputation on the line for you?"
"Zheng Qiming has been with me for eight years."
"Eight years. He has been with you for eight years, and then last week he provided competitive product analysis data for your mother-in-law's brand project. Didn't you know? Su Wanqing went to a consulting company to pitch the proposal, and Zheng Qiming submitted the plan privately." I paused and let the weight of the information fall completely on him. "He has already begun to bet on both ends. Mr. Xu, you have no one left."
Xu Xiangping removed his hand from the coffee cup and placed it on the table. The hand was steady, but his breathing was different—not rapid, but deeper and slower. He is a seasoned poker player who knows when to fold his cards and admit defeat. He stared at me for a long time, then suddenly smiled. That smile was very light and faint, like a person who had lost all his chips and turned over his cards for the last time, only to find that even the cards were blank.
title_en: The Game of True and False Canaries Chapter 18
